title: FIR Decimation
text: 执行多相 FIR 抽取，输入 2 路、输出 1 路、无直接馈通；按 {Output buffer initial conditions} 指定初始条件；{Coefficient source} 指定 FIR 滤波器系数来源、{FIR filter coefficients}、{Decimation factor} 指定抽取因子、{Filter structure} 指定 FIR 滤波器结构 Direct、{Filter object} 指定滤波器对象 dsp.FIRDecimator、{Input processing} 指定处理输入信号的方法 Columns、{Rate options} 指定模块对输入进行抽取所采用的方法 Enforce single-rate、{Allow arbitrary frame length for fixed-size input signals} 允许固定大小输入信号的任意帧长度、{View Filter Response} 指定查看滤波器响应、{Rounding mode} 指定舍入模式 Floor、{Saturate on integer overflow} 指定对整数溢出进行饱和、{Coefficients Data Type} 指定系数数据类型、{Coefficients Minimum} 指定滤波器系数的最小值、{Coefficients Maximum} 指定滤波器系数的最大值、{Product output Data Type} 指定乘积输出数据类型、{Accumulator Data Type} 指定累加器数据类型、{Output Data Type} 输出数据类型、{Output Minimum} 指定模块输出的最小值、{Output Maximum} 指定模块输出的最大值、{Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools} 防止定点工具覆盖数据类型，按实例取值。

params.name: Coefficient source
params.values: FIR 滤波器系数来源 Auto (default) | Dialog parameters | Input port | Filter object

params.name: FIR filter coefficients
params.values: Lowpass FIR filter coefficients designMultirateFIR(1,2) (default) | vector

params.name: Decimation factor
params.values: 抽取因子 2 (default) | positive scalar

params.name: Filter structure
params.values: FIR 滤波器结构 Direct form (default) | Direct form transposed

params.name: Filter object
params.values: 滤波器对象 dsp.FIRDecimator

params.name: Input processing
params.values: 处理输入信号的方法 Columns as channels (frame based) (default) | Elements as channels (sample based)

params.name: Rate options
params.values: 模块对输入进行抽取所采用的方法 Enforce single-rate processing (default) | Allow multirate processing

params.name: Allow arbitrary frame length for fixed-size input signals
params.values: 允许固定大小输入信号的任意帧长度 off (default) | on

params.name: Output buffer initial conditions
params.values: 初始条件 0 (default) | scalar | matrix

params.name: View Filter Response
params.values: 查看滤波器响应 button

params.name: Rounding mode
params.values: 舍入模式 Floor (default) | Ceiling | Convergent | Nearest | Round | Simplest | Zero

params.name: Saturate on integer overflow
params.values: 对整数溢出进行饱和 off (default) | on

params.name: Coefficients Data Type
params.values: 系数数据类型 Inherit: Same word length as input (default) | fixdt(1,16) | fixdt(1,16,0)

params.name: Coefficients Minimum
params.values: 滤波器系数的最小值 [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Coefficients Maximum
params.values: 滤波器系数的最大值 [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Product output Data Type
params.values: 乘积输出数据类型 Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as input | fixdt(1,16,0)

params.name: Accumulator Data Type
params.values: 累加器数据类型 Inherit: Inherit via internal rule (default) | Inherit: Same as input | Inherit: Same as product output | fixdt(1,16,0)

params.name: Output Data Type
params.values: 输出数据类型 Inherit: Same as accumulator (default) | Inherit: Same as input | Inherit: Same as product output | fixdt(1,16,0)

params.name: Output Minimum
params.values: 模块输出的最小值 [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Output Maximum
params.values: 模块输出的最大值 [] (default) | scalar

params.name: Lock data type settings against changes by the fixed-point tools
params.values: 防止定点工具覆盖数据类型 off (default) | on
